title: RRB Group D 27 Nov 2025 Shift 1 - Mathematics - Fractions
subject: Mathematics

questions.q: Two-fifth of a container is filled with blue liquid, one-third of the remaining container is filled with black liquid, five-sixth of the still remaining container is filled with yellow liquid and the remaining 4.2 litres is of white colour. Find the total capacity of the container.
questions.explain:
Let the total capacity be $x$. 
Blue liquid = $\frac{2}{5}x$. Remaining = $x - \frac{2}{5}x = \frac{3}{5}x$.
Black liquid = $\frac{1}{3}$ of $\frac{3}{5}x = \frac{1}{5}x$. Remaining = $\frac{3}{5}x - \frac{1}{5}x = \frac{2}{5}x$.
Yellow liquid = $\frac{5}{6}$ of $\frac{2}{5}x = \frac{1}{3}x$. Remaining = $\frac{2}{5}x - \frac{1}{3}x = \frac{6 - 5}{15}x = \frac{1}{15}x$.
This final remainder is 4.2 L. So, $\frac{1}{15}x = 4.2 \Rightarrow x = 4.2 \times 15 = 63$ litres.
